title: SURROUNDED BY DOZENS OF MIDTOWN BARS ON BROADWAY!
description:
Located in one of the remaining historic buildings in the Midtown area of downtown Nashville - this apartment building is a basically a residential island, literally SURROUNDED on all sides by over two dozen of the city's most popular bars and restaurants. The location is absolutely unbeatable. Immerse yourself in our world of honky-tonks where locals, artists, and music industry executives hang. LIVE WHERE LOCALS WISH THEY COULD - stay in this thriving hotspot for a truly authentic experience!

The space
With the distressed leather and reclaimed wood-- this place will subtly encourage you to fill up a glass of bourbon and relax. 

Built in the 1920's - the unit still claims it's original hardwoods, all tiling, high ceilings, and large windows -- allowing you to watch the thriving day/nightlife around this popular hot spot. This building has not been renovated since the late 40's -- so if you're accustomed to staying at 5 star hotels... you want to keep looking as this place may not be for you! However, if you're looking to enjoy a genuine NASHVILLE experience and submerse yourself in our culture of live music, great food, and maybe too many drinks -- this will be perfect!

This building has A LOT of history -- to name a few, legends Kris Kristofferson, Waylon Jennings, and Johnny Cash have all called this place home at one point or another. Heck-- if its good enough for JOHNNY CASH, its good enough for me.

Guest access
Guests will have complete access of the entire apartment - from the large front porch located  directly on Broadway, to the back balcony and city-style stairs overlooking and leading down from the 3rd floor into midtown's most frequented bars. You'll have full access to the kitchen, an attached dining room, the main bedroom with the full-sized bed, a living-room with a leather couch and lounge chair that you'll sink right into -- plus a closet to store your belongings during your stay.

The building has a parking lot that can fill up, but you can usually find street parking - especially earlier in the day. If necessary, there is metered parking and a pay lot next door. I advise guests to find a spot earlier in the day and then travel by foot since everything will essentially be right next door!

Other things to note
PERMIT NUMBER: 2019001478

You'll be SURROUNDED by at least 30 awesome restaurants and bars (most of which can all be seen from simply glancing out the big windows), but if you wanna head down to the rowdy honky-tonks of Broadway -- one of Nashville's most popular tourist destinations, then just walk a mile down Broadway or grab one of the many cabs you'll be sure to see when you step out the apartment door. 

It's called midtown for a reason! Head about a mile in any direction to reach all of Nashville's unique neighborhoods and scenes.

Please inquire about pet fee.
